objects.description: Alias type representing a count of bits; defaults to an unsigned 8-bit integer unless PCG_BITCOUNT_T overrides it.
128-bit unsigned integer type used by the PCG library. It aliases to the compiler’s native __uint128_t when available; otherwise it is an emulated 128-bit type using uint_x4<uint32_t,uint64_t>.

Core PCG engine template combining an LCG state, a stream policy (increment), a multiplier policy, and an output mixing function. Exposes RNG API, seeding, advancement, serialization, and distance computation. Many concrete RNG typedefs (pcg32, pcg64, etc.) are aliases of specific engine instantiations.

Extended PCG generator that XORs the base engine output with values from an auxiliary table evolved by an invertible auxiliary RNG (extvalclass). Supports periodic table advancement tied to base state (tick/tock), seeding via data array or SeedSeq, setting outputs, and efficient advance/backstep when kdd=true.

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsh_rs_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::xsh_rs_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSH-RS output function: high xorshift then random shift to produce xtype bits from a larger state.
requirements: itype must be at least as wide as xtype and unsigned-like.

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsh_rr_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::xsh_rr_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSH-RR output function: high xorshift then random rotate to produce xtype bits from a larger state.
requirements: itype must be at least as wide as xtype and unsigned-like.

functions.name: pcg_detail::rxs_mixin::output_rxs
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::rxs_mixin<xtype,itype>::output_rxs(itype internal)
functions.description: RXS output core: random xorshift amount applied to internal state to produce xtype. Used as a building block.
requirements: itype must be at least as wide as xtype.

functions.name: pcg_detail::rxs_m_xs_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::rxs_m_xs_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: RXS-M-XS: random xorshift, multiply by MCG constant, then fixed xorshift to yield strong statistical output.
requirements: itype and xtype typically same width; supports unsigned-like types.

functions.name: pcg_detail::rxs_m_xs_mixin::unoutput
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static itype pcg_detail::rxs_m_xs_mixin<xtype,itype>::unoutput(itype internal)
functions.description: Inverse of the RXS-M-XS output permutation for same-width state/output types; used by inside_out and extended machinery.
requirements: Applicable only when result_type and state_type widths are equal and output is a permutation.

functions.name: pcg_detail::rxs_m_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::rxs_m_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: RXS-M: random xorshift followed by MCG multiply to produce xtype bits.
requirements: itype must be at least as wide as xtype.

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsl_rr_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::xsl_rr_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSL-RR: fixed xorshift to lower bits then random rotate; suitable for large (e.g., 128->64) outputs with split registers.
requirements: itype must be wider than xtype.

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsl_rr_rr_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static itype pcg_detail::xsl_rr_rr_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSL-RR-RR: fixed xorshift and two random rotates over halves, producing a same-width itype result (permutes full width).
requirements: itype must have an associated halfsize_trait (provided for 16/32/64/128-bit unsigned types).

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsh_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> static xtype pcg_detail::xsh_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSH: fixed xorshift towards high bits (not recommended at 64 bits or less).
requirements: itype must be wider than or equal to xtype.

functions.name: pcg_detail::xsl_mixin::output
functions.signature: template <typename xtype, typename itype> xtype pcg_detail::xsl_mixin<xtype,itype>::output(itype internal)
functions.description: XSL: fixed xorshift to low bits (not recommended at 64 bits or less).
requirements: itype must be wider than or equal to xtype.

functions.name: pcg_detail::inside_out::external_step
functions.signature: template <typename baseclass> static bool pcg_detail::inside_out<baseclass>::external_step(typename baseclass::result_type& randval, size_t i)
functions.description: One step of the inside-out extension: inverts baseclass output to state, steps it with per-index increment, outputs new value into randval, and returns whether the produced value equals the distinguished zero state.
requirements: baseclass must provide unoutput(), multiplier(), increment(), output(), and distance semantics; result_type and state_type must be same width (per static_assert).

functions.name: pcg_detail::inside_out::external_advance
functions.signature: template <typename baseclass> static bool pcg_detail::inside_out<baseclass>::external_advance(typename baseclass::result_type& randval, size_t i, typename baseclass::result_type delta, bool forwards = true)
functions.description: Advances the inside-out value by delta steps (forwards or backwards), updating randval; reports whether the sequence crosses the distinguished zero state.
requirements: baseclass must provide unoutput(), output(), advance(), distance(), multiplier(), increment().

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::period_pow2
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> static constexpr size_t pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::period_pow2()
functions.description: Returns log2 of the period of the extended generator: base period plus table_size * extvalclass period.

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::operator()
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> typename pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::result_type pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::operator()()
functions.description: Generates the next value as base RNG output XOR an extended table value derived from state; also advances table occasionally (tick/tock).

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::operator()
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> typename pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::result_type pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::operator()(result_type upper_bound)
functions.description: Generates a bounded random value in [0, upper_bound) by applying bounded_rand to the extended engine.
requirements: upper_bound must be > 0.

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::set
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> void pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::set(result_type wanted)
functions.description: Forces the next output to be 'wanted' by setting the extended table entry to base_output XOR wanted.

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::advance
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> void pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::advance(state_type distance, bool forwards = true)
functions.description: Advances the extended generator by distance steps; updates both base RNG state and extended table via inside-out external_advance with tick/tock logic.
requirements: kdd must be true for efficient advance; otherwise the code suggests casting to base class for a weaker advance.

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::backstep
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> void pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::backstep(state_type distance)
functions.description: Moves the extended generator backward by distance steps (equivalent to advance(distance, false)).

functions.name: pcg_detail::extended::seed
functions.signature: template <pcg_extras::bitcount_t table_pow2, pcg_extras::bitcount_t advance_pow2, typename baseclass, typename extvalclass, bool kdd> template <typename... Args> void pcg_detail::extended<table_pow2,advance_pow2,baseclass,extvalclass,kdd>::seed(Args&&... args)
functions.description: Re-seeds the extended engine by reconstructing it with the forwarded arguments (calls placement new).
requirements: Arguments must match a valid constructor of extended.
